experiment: CBMC bit-precise verification of RTNN finite runtime contract

sources.budget_lowering_status: exact deployed one-line Q0.16 formula represented in proof harness; full neural core is not CBMC-linked because generated weights are intentionally external build artifacts

continuous_budget_lowering.domain: all uint16_t Q0.16 budgets, plus arbitrary ordered budget pairs
properties: class always lies in 0..6
lowering is monotone
selected finite class fraction never exceeds the admitted continuous budget
selected class is the greatest finite class that fits

actual_deadline_admission.domain: all uint32_t deadlines for the committed RTL-measured binding
properties: wrong model identity fails closed
wrong build identity fails closed
null binding fails closed
returned class is in range
returned class timing bound fits the deadline
no higher class also fits
negative admission occurs exactly when class zero does not fit

partial_certification.domain: arbitrary seven-entry uint32_t timing tables, arbitrary uint32_t deadline, arbitrary probe class k in 0..6
properties: no-admission implies an arbitrary certified class k does not fit
an admitted class is not marked invalid
an admitted class fits the deadline
an arbitrary higher certified class k cannot also fit

effective_execution_safety.domain: all uint16_t budgets, all uint32_t deadlines, all preferred exits 0..5
properties: effective execution never exceeds budget ceiling
effective execution never exceeds deadline ceiling
effective execution never exceeds preferred compute
effective execution never exceeds deployed policy max exit 5
executed class RTL binding is no larger than the admitted class binding
executed class RTL binding remains within the deadline whenever admission succeeds

q15_lut_index_bounds.domain: arbitrary signed 32-bit inputs to the exact post-clamp index arithmetic
properties: exp interpolation high index <= 8192 for fx_exp_lut[8193]
GELU interpolation high index <= 4096 for fx_gelu_lut[4097]
CBMC signed-overflow instrumentation reports no reachable overflow in the clamp-to-index subtraction

solver_result: all five proof entry points report VERIFICATION SUCCESSFUL with unwinding assertions enabled where loops are present
evidence_chain: pinned Ibex RTL measured timing binding
exact RV32 binary input/control-flow noninterference audit
nonclaims: This is not a proof of the full neural arithmetic implementation.
This is not a proof that the C compiler preserves all source-level noninterference properties; exact-binary taint evidence is separate.
This is not a formal proof of the Ibex RTL pipeline or memory subsystem; pinned RTL measurement is separate evidence.
This is not an FPGA, ASIC, or physical-silicon WCET certificate.
